title: Lennar Breaks Ground on The Premiere at Monmouth, Bringing New Homes to Fort Monmouth's Revitalization
summary: Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today broke ground on The Premiere at Monmouth, a new community of single-family homes and townhomes within the 1,226-acre Fort Monmouth...
body_markdown:
EATONTOWN, N.J.


, Oct. 21, 2026


/[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/) / -- Lennar, one of the nation's leading homebuilders, today broke ground on The Premiere at Monmouth, a new community of single-family homes and townhomes within the 1,226-acre Fort Monmouth redevelopment. Rising on a site that sat vacant for more than two decades, the community will introduce new homeownership opportunities as the former U.S. Army installation transforms into a vibrant destination to live, work and play. With convenient access to shopping, dining, entertainment and employment opportunities, The Premiere at Monmouth will feature 32 single-family homes and 188 townhomes. Sales are anticipated to begin in late fall 2026.


Lennar New Jersey–New York Division leaders joined Eatontown Mayor Anthony Talerico Jr. and municipal and community representatives for the ceremonial groundbreaking, marking a milestone in the continued transformation of Fort Monmouth into a destination.


"For decades, the Howard Commons area of the former Fort Monmouth provided housing to hundreds of military families. Now, after many years of lying vacant, the Borough of Eatontown is ready to welcome new families to this area," said Eatontown Mayor Anthony Talerico Jr. "I hope those that move into The Premiere at Monmouth find themselves as welcome in our community as those that have come before them."


"The Premiere at Monmouth gives Monmouth County families a new place to call home at the center of one of the most exciting redevelopment stories on the Jersey Shore," said Dana Romano, New Jersey–New York Division President for Lennar. "We are proud to bring this community to Eatontown and to be part of Fort Monmouth's next chapter."


The Premiere at Monmouth is approximately five miles from the Jersey Shore and near an expanding mix of shopping, dining, entertainment and employment opportunities, with nearby NJ Transit service and commuter routes to New York City. The community will also be minutes from the future Netflix Studios East campus, a 292-acre production facility expected to generate significant employment and economic activity in the region.


Every home will include Lennar's signature Everything's Included® program, which incorporates popular features and finishes into the base price.


For more information about The Premiere at Monmouth, visit lennar.com or call us at 609-349-8258.


**About Lennar Corporation**


Lennar Corporation is one of the nation's leading homebuilders, dedicated to making the American dream of homeownership attainable for more people. Since its founding in 1954, Lennar has built more than 1.5 million homes for buyers at every stage of life in communities across the country, from first-time and move-up buyers to active adults. Lennar's Financial Services segment provides mortgage financing, title and closing services primarily for buyers of Lennar's homes. LENX drives Lennar's technology, innovation and strategic investments, shaping the future of homebuilding.
